correctness.rationale: PASS. For spherical-probability and torus-Haar normalizations, the doubled latitude map yields a diagonal degree-l Gram matrix in azimuthal m, with d_{l,m}=(2/pi)∫ p_{l,m}(x)^2/sqrt(1-x²) dx. The normalized associated-Legendre symmetric Jacobi recurrence has local coefficient limit sqrt(1−alpha²)/2 for |m|/l→alpha; moment convergence gives the arcsine law of radius sqrt(1−alpha²), including the alpha=1 point mass. For alpha>0, the angular gradient estimate m²∫ p²/(1−x²) <=l(l+1) makes the singular Jacobian uniformly integrable and yields (4/pi²)K(sqrt(1−alpha²)); for alpha=0 bounded truncations force divergence rather than relying on weak convergence for an unbounded function. Pointwise weight >1 gives d>2/pi, while the exact beta sectoral formula tends to 2/pi. Parseval for the Legendre generating function yields zonal d_{l,0}=(2l+1)sum_r b_r² b_{l−r}²=(4/pi²)log l+O(1). Independent quadrature at l=0,1,2,6,14 agreed with zonal/sectoral formulas. The finite checks are not a substitute for the Jacobi/endpoint argument.
